name: Wonderful Sky Financial Group Holdings Limited
summary: Wonderful Sky Financial Group Holdings Limited is an investment holding company providing financial communications and international roadshow services in Hong Kong, mainland China and Singapore. Its offerings include corporate positioning, media relations, listing events, investor relations such as forums and shareholder identification, roadshow project management and virtual roadshows. It also offers financial printing of prospectuses and reports and corporate branding through outdoor, print, television and digital advertising.
